title: SWOT Analysis of Home-Based Learning during COVID-19 from Pre-University Students’ Perspectives
descriptions: The dataset refers to responses obtained from a questionnaire used in a study to evaluate students' perceived strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats from their experience undergoing home-based online learning in Malaysia. This file contains 15 sample questionnaire feedbacks for the study: SWOT Analysis of Home-Based Learning during COVID-19 from Pre-University Students’ Perspectives.
